about: The Bitcoin mainnet block headers this case's verifier holds (anchoring 0.2.0: a header_file source named by the trust policy; draft-fassbender-scitt-time-anchor-08: the verifier's validated chain, route 2). Pinned on 7 November 2026; read offline by verify.py. Each entry: the 80-byte header as hex, its block hash computed locally (SHA-256 of SHA-256 of the header, bytes reversed) and miner_stated_time, the header's nTime (bytes 68 to 71, little-endian) as UTC: the miner's statement, never a time anything existed at.

checkpoint.about: the point the verifier holds; validate_chain anchors the set here and checks linkage, proof of work, powLimit and the difficulty rule from it (interop/umarise/verify_anchor.py)

limit: two block explorers are not the verifier's own node: what the set shows is real proof of work above the checkpoint, not that it is the most-work chain from genesis (interop/umarise/README.md).
